title: Repository-local AEC owner declaration
$comment: Draft declaration shape. Registration must resolve the designated owner, authority, declared RAC link, and exact Rego source independently. Structural validation does not authorize exercise.

owner.description: Registration reference for the designated AEC condition owner.

authority.description: Registered authority to which the exercise condition applies.

required_rac.description: Registered RAC condition linked by the AEC owner. The exercise request pins the RAC contract revision.

operation.description: Registered operation for which exercise is evaluated.

target_type.description: Registered type of the operation target.

source.description: Reference to the approved exact Rego source revision.

entrypoint.description: Entry point for the exercise condition in that source.
